_help: OOMPAS Box channel lineup. Edit freely; restart the server to apply (today's schedule is rebuilt).
kind: archive (Internet Archive tapes), guide, weather (drawn live on your PC), mirror (plays a Spelunkr channel's schedule).
pools: named Internet Archive searches (archive.org advanced-search syntax; 'AND mediatype:movies' is added for you).
runs: play this many episodes of a series in a row. episodes: look inside multi-file items for episodes.
name: the block's name in the guide; one name, or one per part of the day {morning, afternoon, prime, late}.
label: what kind of program it is (Movie, Cartoon, Documentary...). Left out, it's worked out from the length.
list: how the guide's grid names programs: block (the block name), title (each film), series (series name, else title). Follows the label if left out.
minMin / maxMin: only use tapes this long (minutes). rows: how many search results to use (most-viewed first).
blocks: dayparts, e.g. {"from": "15:00", "to": "18:00", "pool": "action"}; outside blocks the 'main' pool plays.
ads: put a short pod of vintage commercials between shows. Channels may share pools; the scheduler never airs
the same tape on two channels at the same time. Spelunkr's own channels appear above these, at 100 + their dial.

music._help: Music for the Guide and Weather channels: in-store tapes, paulstretched and given reverb. Set "music": null to turn off. Your own files in pc-server/music play too.

adPool.q: collection:(classic_tv_commercials OR adviews) OR (collection:prelinger AND subject:(commercial OR commercials OR advertising))
